title: Fairness without Demographics through Adversarially Reweighted Learning
reasoning: The paper is a technical machine learning research article focused on algorithmic fairness. While it uses the Rawlsian principle of Max-Min welfare to motivate its objective function, it evaluates its method on standard demographic classification datasets (income, law school admission, recidivism) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or formal systems of morals and ethics.
